background_workflow: flat #00ff00 chroma-key generated by gpt-image-2, then local chroma removal to PNG alpha
source_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: project-bound gpt-image-2 source asset for a Live2D-riggable iOS magic sticker wardrobe character. Create a beautiful full-body front-facing anime wardrobe assistant girl, elegant sweet lolita / magical wardrobe style, young adult stylized character, large expressive eyes, soft smile, long layered hair with clearly separable front hair, side hair, and back hair masses, pastel pink and sky-blue outfit, delicate bow and heart accents, arms relaxed slightly away from body, legs visible, shoes visible, symmetrical neutral A-pose suitable for cutting into riggable parts and binding bones. Composition: centered full body, generous padding, vertical 3:4 canvas. Style: polished 2D mobile game character illustration, clean line art, soft cel shading, refined and cute, not chibi, not childish, high quality character design. Background: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key only, no shadows, no gradient, no texture, no floor plane. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no phone UI, no cropped limbs, no fused fingers, no realistic photo, do not use #00ff00 or green anywhere in the character.
notes: No Pencil output is used for the committed avatar asset.
Layer PNGs are first-pass engineering crops from the gpt-image-2 full-body source.
Final Cubism production should redraw hidden overdraw for joints before binding.
